lessons.title: Basic contract vocabulary
lessons.description: Understand a small set of common words used when discussing contracts.
objectives: Explain a basic contract concept in plain English.
Distinguish a party from an obligation.

vocabulary.example: Each party must read the agreement.
Payment is one of the buyer's obligations.

sections.heading: Plain-English explanation
sections.body: A contract is an agreement that creates obligations for the parties. The exact legal effect depends on the applicable law and the facts.

sections.heading: Important note
sections.body: This lesson teaches English vocabulary only. It is not legal advice and does not determine the law that applies to a real dispute.

quiz.question: What does “obligation” mean in this lesson?
quiz.explanation: An obligation is something a person or party is required to do.
